summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Silvercorp Metals Inc. reporting fiscal Q4 2026 financial results. It highlights record revenue, adjusted net income, and operating cash flow, along with an update on the prior acquisition of a 70% stake in Chaarat ZAAV CJSC. No new special-situation event is announced; the filing is a routine earnings release. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic review are included.
